Nora Blake: Heads up 11 Partner OrchNet wants a seat-based minimum + burst-credit model mapped to our marketplace SKUs. They also want a daily "invoice-preview" feed and an auditable reconciliation report. Who owns mapping + entitlement lifecycle?

Ethan Wu: I can lead mapping. Clarify: seat-minimum is a guaranteed monthly minimum per entitlement (e.g., 10 seats) + burst credits consumed above baseline?

Mira (PartnerOps): Correct. Example: entitlement E-100 has min 10 seats billed monthly even if active seats <10. Burst credits consumed as GB overage and reported as separate SKU lines. We need preview to show min-charge line + actual usage lines.

Carla Rivera: For reconciliation we'll need three columns: partner_reported_seats, our_active_seats, min_charge_applied (yes/no). Also show burst_reported_units vs our_burst_units.

Sam (Billing): CSV preview schema proposal: entitlement_id, sku, period_start, period_end, partner_seats, our_seats, min_seats, seat_unit_price_cents, seat_line_total_cents, burst_units, burst_unit_price_cents, burst_line_total_cents, total_cents, notes. Is that acceptable?

Nora Blake: Yes. Partner also requires signed manifests for each daily file and an encrypted per-file checksum (they use AWS KMS). Can Legal/Security confirm constraints?

Levi (Security): Signed manifests + HMAC ok; for KMS-wrapped checksums we'll accept KMS-encrypted checksum as an opaque string, but require us to verify payload integrity via SHA256 and signature. We'll add a contract clause for key rotation schedule.

Ethan Wu: Operational plan: 1) mapping table with two SKUs per entitlement: <sku>-SEAT and <sku>-BURST 2) daily preview at 04:00 UTC for prior day 3) 14-day shadow run 4) reconciliation report with delta_pct and absolute delta, flagged if delta_pct >0.6% or >$100 absolute.

Mira (PartnerOps): We also need per-entitlement lifecycle events in preview: created_at, suspended_at, terminated_at. If entitlement suspended mid-period, min_seat should prorate by days active.

Carla Rivera: SQL sketch for prorating min seats:
```sql
SELECT entitlement_id,
  SUM(GREATEST(0, LEAST(period_end, active_until) - GREATEST(period_start, active_from)) / (period_end - period_start) * min_seats) AS prorated_min_seats
FROM entitlement_active_windows
WHERE period_start < active_until AND active_from < period_end
GROUP BY entitlement_id;
```

Sam (Billing): Rounding / billing rules: seat_monthly_min billed as integer seats (round up prorated value to nearest whole seat), seat price applied per-seat-month, burst billed per-GB with 3 decimal precision, line totals rounded to cents.

Nora Blake: Partner wants an "invoice-preview" that includes a human-friendly breakdown and machine CSV. We should produce both. Marketing wants friendly labels but partner will review raw CSV first.

Mira (PartnerOps): Also asking for an "audit bundle" for each preview containing: raw manifest, signed_manifest, file_checksum, sha256_hash, and reconciliation diff JSON. We'll deliver via S3 with access logs.

Levi (Security): Ensure S3 objects use SSE-KMS with customer-managed keys for the audit bundle. We'll need bucket policy review.

Ethan Wu: Shadow run details: ingest partner daily files into staging, run seat-count reconciliation (partner_seats vs active_sessions), compute min-seat application and burst aggregation, produce preview CSV + audit bundle, compare to partner totals and emit daily delta report. If rolling 7-day error rate <0.6%, we auto-promote to GA.

Carla Rivera: Alerting rules: open MP ticket if delta_pct >0.6% OR absolute >$100 for any entitlement. If >3 entitlements fail the check in a day, escalate to oncall and pause GA for OrchNet. ops-bot please create a playbook entry.

ops-bot: Created ticket MP-999: "OrchNet seat-minimum + burst SKU mapping and 14-day shadow run" assigned Ethan Wu, watchers: Nora Blake, Carla Rivera, Sam (Billing), Mira (PartnerOps), Levi (Security).

Mira (PartnerOps): Timeline: Partner wants preview samples for two entitlements (one seat-heavy, one burst-heavy) within 5 business days. They also want the lifecycle events included.

Ethan Wu: Action items: 1) I'll produce mapping table + sample CSVs by Fri EOD 2) Carla will add prorate SQL and reconciliation queries 3) Sam will codify billing rounding rules 4) Levi will review S3/KMS audit bundle policy 5) Mira to coordinate partner acceptance and run shadow. Nora will draft partner-facing kickoff doc.

Sam (Billing): Example sample CSV row (seat-heavy):
```
ent_100,ORC-BASIC-SEAT,2026-03-01T00:00:00Z,2026-03-31T23:59:59Z,partner_seats=8,our_seats=6,min_seats=10,seat_price_cents=5000,seat_line_total_cents=50000,burst_units=12.345,burst_price_cents=200,burst_line_total_cents=2469,total_cents=52469,notes="min_seat applied, prorated"
```

Carla Rivera: We'll include a "recon_delta" CSV daily with columns: entitlement_id, metric, partner_value, our_value, delta_pct, action (none/escalate).

Nora Blake: Once shadow deltas are stable for 14 days, we'll publish marketplace listing and schedule joint announcement. Marketing wants final numbers 7 business days before announcement.

Mira (PartnerOps): OrchNet will provide manifest spec and sample files by tomorrow. We'll schedule partner review call after sample CSVs are posted.

Levi (Security): I'll add a short checklist for key rotation, bucket policies, and access reviews to MP-999.

Ethan Wu: I'll attach a small Python validator for manifest + checksum verification to the ticket.

Nora Blake: Great work. Closing loop: Ethan/Carla/Sam/Levi/Mira to sync on MP-999 updates by Thu 11:00 PT. ops-bot keep MP-999 open until post-GA 30-day reconciliation completes. :thumbsup:
